hypothesis: Explicit baselines and paired drilldowns can shorten regression triage.
method_dataset: Product documentation. No AI Labs usability experiment.
findings: Baseline comparison, expandable trials, regression filters and side-by-side diffs are documented.
self_declared_limitations: Trace-level comparison required. Field diffs have a documented character limit.
unanswered_gaps: Does comparison eligibility remain understandable across native harness versions?
contradictions: Automatic latest-branch baseline is unsuitable for a fixed scientific control.
transfer_conditions: Match immutable task/world/harness/model/settings before displaying deltas.

citation: UK AI Security Institute. Log Viewer. Live documentation.
hypothesis: An outcome-to-trace drilldown can preserve context when diagnosing a failed task.
method_dataset: Viewer documentation and repository MIT license.
findings: History, live samples, messages, grading and metadata can be inspected.
self_declared_limitations: Network exposure has authorization and trusted-origin requirements.
unanswered_gaps: Can AI Labs link every finding to stable event/check identifiers?
transfer_conditions: Adapt viewer concepts without replacing the native competitor harness.

citation: xyflow. Workflow Editor and Undo and Redo. Updated August 24 2026.

unanswered_gaps: Which functions should be implemented against MIT core?
contradictions: Core MIT does not imply Pro template reuse rights.

citation: Langfuse. Experiments via UI. Live documentation.
hypothesis: A shared experiment/trace model can connect development runs to evidence.
method_dataset: Product documentation and scoped MIT license.
findings: Prompt experiments use dataset mappings and evaluator setup. Full agents use SDK or webhook routes.
self_declared_limitations: Prompt-only UI cannot execute arbitrary full agent configuration.
unanswered_gaps: Can existing trace IDs be preserved across versioned AI Labs runs?
contradictions: Prompt experiment path differs from native harness evaluation requirement.
transfer_conditions: Use full application instrumentation and preserve evaluation isolation.

citation: Arize. Phoenix repository and experiment client API. Live documentation.
